sections.label: EFFECT
sections.html: When a creature makes a roll that targets or directly affects you, that creature may consume your Exposed to roll 1 additional die.

sections.label: LIMIT
sections.html: Exposed cannot be consumed for a roll that does not target or directly affect the Exposed creature.

sections.label: REMOVAL
sections.html: Effects that remove ordinary Conditions do not remove Specialty Conditions unless they explicitly say so.
